paragraphs: In [Chullin 107a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.107a.9): “Rav Ashi instituted in Hutzal.” Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rav Assi.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rav Ashi at Hutzal in the account of vessels for handwashing. Hyman calls the name a scribal error and proposes Rav Assi.
